items.lede: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
items.title: Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms

items.lede: Following improvements made to Chrome's enhanced autofill last year that included your name, passport number, email address, and physical addresses sourced from your Google Accounts and services like Google Wallet, the feature is now expanding.
